sqlMap.select: SELECT AR_CALENDER.DDATE, AR_CALENDER.IYEAR, AR_CALENDER.IMONTH, AR_CALENDER.IDAY, AR_CALENDER.IWEEK, AR_CALENDER.TYPEID, AR_CALENDER.OVERTYPEID, AR_CALENDER.WORKDAYFLAG, AR_CALENDER.SHIFT_NO, AR_CALENDER.TYPEID_DEFAULT, T_SCHEDULE.SCHEDULE_SHIFT_NO, T_SCHEDULE.DATATYPE, SY1.CONTENT TYPENAME, SY2.CONTENT SHIFT_NAME, SY3.CONTENT DATETYPENAME, TO_CHAR(AR_CALENDER.DDATE,'YYYY-MM-DD') VIEW_DDATE, #PERSON_ID:VARCHAR# VIEW_PERSON_ID FROM AR_CALENDER, (SELECT T1.SHIFT_NO SCHEDULE_SHIFT_NO, T1.AR_DATE_STR, T2.DATATYPE FROM AR_SCHEDULE_$CPNY_ID$ T1, AR_SHIFT010 T2 WHERE T1.SHIFT_NO = T2.SHIFT_NO AND T1.PERSON_ID = #PERSON_ID:VARCHAR#) T_SCHEDULE, SY_GLOBAL_NAME SY1, SY_GLOBAL_NAME SY2, SY_GLOBAL_NAME SY3 WHERE AR_CALENDER.CPNY_ID = #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR# AND AR_CALENDER.DDATE = to_date(T_SCHEDULE.AR_DATE_STR(+),'yyyy-mm-dd') AND AR_CALENDER.DDATE BETWEEN GET_AR_START_DATE(#AR_MONTH:VARCHAR#, #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR#,#STAT_NO:VARCHAR#) AND GET_AR_END_DATE(#AR_MONTH:VARCHAR#, #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR#,#STAT_NO:VARCHAR#) AND AR_CALENDER.TYPEID = SY1.NO(+) AND SY1.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# AND AR_CALENDER.SHIFT_NO = SY2.NO(+) AND SY2.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# AND T_SCHEDULE.DATATYPE = SY3.NO(+) AND SY3.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# ORDER BY AR_CALENDER.DDATE

SELECT T.SHIFT_NO, SY.CONTENT SHIFT_NAME, T.DATATYPE, T.SHIFT_ID FROM AR_SHIFT010 T, SY_GLOBAL_NAME SY WHERE T.SHIFT_NO = SY.NO(+) AND SY.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# AND T.CPNY_ID = #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR# AND T.ACTIVITY = 1
(T.DEPT_DISTINGUISH_NO IS NULL OR T.DEPT_DISTINGUISH_NO IN (SELECT HR_DEPARTMENT.DEPT_DISTINGUISH_NO FROM HR_EMPLOYEE,HR_DEPARTMENT WHERE HR_EMPLOYEE.PERSON_ID = #PERSON_ID:VARCHAR# AND HR_EMPLOYEE.DEPTNO = HR_DEPARTMENT.DEPTNO))
sqlMap.delete: DELETE FROM AR_SCHEDULE_$CPNY_ID$ T WHERE T.PERSON_ID = #PERSON_ID:VARCHAR# AND TO_DATE(T.AR_DATE_STR,'YYYY-MM-DD') = TO_DATE(#DDATE_STR#, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND T.LOCK_YN ='N'
sqlMap.select: SELECT COUNT(T.EMPID) FROM AR_SCHEDULE T WHERE T.EMPID = #EMPID# AND T.AR_DATE_STR = TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#DDATE_STR#, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'YYYY/MM/DD')
sqlMap.insert: INSERT INTO AR_SCHEDULE_$CPNY_ID$ (PK_NO, PERSON_ID, SHIFT_NO, AR_DATE_STR, LOCK_YN, CREATE_DATE, CREATED_BY) VALUES (Ar_Schedule_Seq.NEXTVAL, #PERSON_ID#, #SHIFT_NO#, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#DDATE_STR#,'YYYY/MM/DD'),'YYYY/MM/DD'), 'N', SYSDATE, #CREATED_BY:VARCHAR#)
sqlMap.select: SELECT HR.LOCAL_NAME, HR.EMPID, HR.PERSON_ID, HR.CPNY_ID, HD.CONTENT DEPTNAME, GET_AR_STATNO(HR.PERSON_ID,HR.CPNY_ID) STAT_NO FROM HR_EMPLOYEE HR, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME HD WHERE HR.DEPTNO = HD.DEPTNO(+) AND HD.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# AND HR.PERSON_ID = #person_id:VARCHAR#

SELECT SY.CONTENT SHIFT_NAME FROM AR_SHIFT010 T, SY_GLOBAL_NAME SY WHERE T.SHIFT_NO = SY.NO(+) AND T.SHIFT_NO = #DAILY_SHIFT_NO:VARCHAR# AND SY.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# AND T.CPNY_ID = #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR#

SELECT HE.EMPID, HE.PERSON_ID, HE.LOCAL_NAME, HDNAME.CONTENT DEPT_NAME, GET_AR_STATNO(HE.PERSON_ID,HE.CPNY_ID) STAT_NO, HD.CPNY_ID FROM HR_EMPLOYEE HE, HR_DEPARTMENT HD, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME HDNAME WHERE HE.DEPTNO = HD.DEPTNO AND HD.DEPTNO = HDNAME.DEPTNO(+) AND HDNAME.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# AND HE.CPNY_ID = #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR#
EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM AR_SUPERVISOR_INFO F WHERE HE.DEPTNO = F.DEPTNO AND F.PERSON_ID = #AR_SUPERVISOR_ID:VARCHAR# )
( HE.EMPID LIKE '%' || #KEY:VARCHAR# || '%' OR HE.LOCAL_NAME LIKE '%' || #KEY:VARCHAR# || '%' )
EXISTS( SELECT * FROM HR_DEPARTMENT WHERE HR_DEPARTMENT.DEPTNO = HE.DEPTNO AND HR_DEPARTMENT.ACTIVITY = 1 START WITH (HR_DEPARTMENT.DEPTNO = #DEPTNO_TREE:VARCHAR# OR #DEPTNO_TREE:VARCHAR# = '') CONNECT BY PRIOR HR_DEPARTMENT.DEPTNO = HR_DEPARTMENT.PARENT_DEPT_NO )
ORDER BY HE.DEPTNO,HE.EMPID

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM HR_EMPLOYEE HE, HR_DEPARTMENT HD WHERE HE.DEPTNO = HD.DEPTNO AND HE.CPNY_ID = #CPNY_ID:VARCHAR#
EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM AR_SUPERVISOR_INFO F WHERE HE.DEPTNO = F.DEPTNO AND F.PERSON_ID = #AR_SUPERVISOR_ID:VARCHAR# )
( HE.EMPID LIKE '%' || #KEY:VARCHAR# || '%' OR HE.LOCAL_NAME LIKE '%' || #KEY:VARCHAR# || '%' )
EXISTS( SELECT * FROM HR_DEPARTMENT WHERE HR_DEPARTMENT.DEPTNO = HE.DEPTNO AND HR_DEPARTMENT.ACTIVITY = 1 START WITH (HR_DEPARTMENT.DEPTNO = #DEPTNO_TREE:VARCHAR# OR #DEPTNO_TREE:VARCHAR# = '') CONNECT BY PRIOR HR_DEPARTMENT.DEPTNO = HR_DEPARTMENT.PARENT_DEPT_NO )

SELECT GET_GLOBAL_NAME(T1.LEAVE_TYPE_CODE, #VIEW_LANGUAGE:VARCHAR#) LEAVE_TYPE_NAME, CASE WHEN TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(T1.LEAVE_FROM_TIME,'HH24:MI:SS'),'HH24:MI:SS') >= TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(T2.FROM_TIME,'HH24:MI:SS'),'HH24:MI:SS') THEN TO_CHAR(T1.LEAVE_FROM_TIME,'HH24:MI:SS') ELSE TO_CHAR(T2.FROM_TIME,'HH24:MI:SS') END FROM_TIME, CASE WHEN TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(T1.LEAVE_TO_TIME,'HH24:MI:SS'),'HH24:MI:SS') <= TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(T2.TO_TIME,'HH24:MI:SS'),'HH24:MI:SS') THEN TO_CHAR(T1.LEAVE_TO_TIME,'HH24:MI:SS') ELSE TO_CHAR(T2.TO_TIME,'HH24:MI:SS') END TO_TIME FROM ESS_LEAVE_APPLY_TB T1, (SELECT MIN(FROM_TIME) FROM_TIME,MAX(TO_TIME) TO_TIME FROM ar_shift020 WHERE SHIFT_NO = #DAILY_SHIFT_NO:VARCHAR#) T2 WHERE T1.ACTIVITY = 1 AND T1.PERSON_ID = #VIEW_PERSON_ID:VARCHAR# AND TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(T1.LEAVE_FROM_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') <= TO_DATE(#VIEW_DDATE:VARCHAR#,'YYYY-MM-DD') AND TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(T1.LEAVE_TO_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') >= TO_DATE(#VIEW_DDATE:VARCHAR#,'YYYY-MM-DD')
